t: I Trained Like A Black Belt For 90 Days
d: Michelle attempts to earn a black belt in taekwondo in just 90 days.
Michelle spends a day working alongside San Diego's sanitation workers to experience the challenges, dangers, and hard work behind one of America's most lethal and essential jobs.
Michelle trains with real homicide detectives, crime scene analysts, and forensic experts to investigate a simulated murder case.

Michelle embarks on a year-long journey to find two perfect wedding dresses—a classic Western gown and a traditional Indian lehenga—to honor both her heritage and surprise her fiancé on their wedding day.
Michelle spends a week training at the “Harvard” of Santa Schools.

t: I Learned How To Cook Like A Professional Chef
d: Michelle trains at a professional culinary school to master knife skills, classic cooking techniques, and plating, then faces the pressure of preparing a full four-course meal for a panel of food critics.

t: I Tried The Navy SEAL Fitness Test
d: Michelle embarks on a rigorous training journey to prepare for the Navy SEAL physical screening test.

t: I Trained Like Miss USA For 60 Days
d: After 60 days of training, Michelle competes in her first real beauty pageant, navigating talent performances, Q&A, and evening gown rounds under high pressure.

t: I Competed In A Beauty Pageant For The First Time
d: Michelle experiences a 60-day intensive pageant training program with a professional pageant coach, focusing on fitness, interview techniques, and stage presence, to prepare for a Miss USA competition.

t: I Tried Planning My Wedding In A Week
d: Michelle and her fiancé Garrett take on the challenge of planning their entire wedding in just one week in hopes of turning months of decisions into one unforgettable, fun-filled seven-day sprint.

t: I Surprised Tom Cruise At His Own Premiere
d: Michelle attends the Mission: Impossible premiere undercover in attempt to meet Tom Cruise.
Michelle trains with the top motion-capture coaches in the industry to see what it's really like to physically perform to successfully embody our favorite CGI characters.
